q: 서울 지역 매출 상위 5개 고객사를 알려줘
hint: sales + clients 조인, region='서울', GROUP BY, ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 5
gold: SELECT c.name FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.clients c ON c.id = s.client_id WHERE s.region = '서울' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY SUM(s.amount) DESC, c.name LIMIT 5
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM companyx.sales WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

q: 보안 솔루션 카테고리 제품들의 월 평균 매출은?
gold: SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM companyx.sales WHERE category = 'security'

q: 현재 활성 상태인 계약 수는 몇 개야?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT e.name, e.salary FROM companyx.employees e JOIN companyx.departments d ON d.id = e.dept_id WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀' ORDER BY e.id

q: 가장 많은 프로젝트를 진행 중인 고객사는?
hint: projects JOIN clients, GROUP BY client_id, ORDER BY COUNT DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM companyx.projects p JOIN companyx.clients c ON c.id = p.client_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY n DESC, c.name LIMIT 1

q: Critical 우선순위 티켓 중 아직 해결되지 않은 건은?
hint: support_tickets WHERE priority='critical' AND status IN ('open','in_progress')
gold: SELECT id, title FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'critical' AND status IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY id

q: 제품별 총 계약 금액을 큰 순서로 보여줘
hint: contracts JOIN products, GROUP BY product_id, SUM(amount) ORDER BY DESC
gold: SELECT p.name, SUM(c.amount) AS total FROM companyx.contracts c JOIN companyx.products p ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total DESC, p.name
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'

q: 평균 연봉이 가장 높은 부서는 어디야?
hint: employees JOIN departments, GROUP BY dept_id, AVG(salary) ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
gold: SELECT d.name FROM companyx.employees e JOIN companyx.departments d ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY AVG(e.salary) DESC, d.name LIMIT 1
